item.title: Ep 6: Four EU hopefuls, including Ukraine, could get timed road maps to membership.
item.description: Omni View Europe Four EU hopefuls, including Ukraine, could get timed road maps to membership. What You Need to Know: The European Commission is drawing up timed accession road maps for Ukraine, Montenegro, Moldova and Albania, the four it treats as closest to joining. Officials say the plans would set reform duties, cluster dates and, if the reforms continue, a path to admission, while other candidates would not get the same offer now. ...
